verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It shows that the intersection O of the perpendicular bisectors of the diagonals is preserved by every partnership step, and consequently both the multiset of vertex distances from O and the multiset of side lengths are invariant. For each ordering of these two finite multisets, fixing O and one vertex leaves at most two choices at each of the next three circle-intersection steps, so only finitely many configurations, hence finitely many congruence classes, can occur. This rules out an infinite sequence of pairwise noncongruent quadrilaterals. No external references or internal fact citations require checking, and no hard prohibition is triggered.
